name: Connecting only while Wizard hasn't answered
author: wizard
description: WizardOS Android app: the "Connecting to your Wizard…" screen leaves as soon as your Wizard answers, instead of when the page first paints, so a home-screen app your Wizard answers at once opens without it. With Tailscale off or no network you still see why within a moment, and a Wizard that answers but never shows a page still ends on the Retry screen after 10 seconds.
